sourceOnlyFindings.finding: Review metadata is optional, user-supplied, validated and logged, and does not change the mechanical verdict.
Claims bind spec/verifier hashes and HEAD, with a dirty boolean, but contain no digest or immutable snapshot of the dirty candidate tree; checks run before the diff and HEAD are collected.
Check commands run with inherited environment and shell=True. The boundary suite sanitizes its test environment, but that is not an isolation feature of the general verifier.
Service ready/stop probes have no subprocess timeout; readiness failure during __enter__ has no guaranteed __exit__ cleanup. Arbitrary check descendants are outside the proven correction.
A real contradiction takes precedence over harness errors in a mixed run; this is unchanged by the patch.

recommendedNextTranche: Define an explicit result protocol for unmet requirements versus unusable harness evidence, so an import/setup error cannot establish valid baseline red.
Review and protect the execution chain of completion checks, and require evidence that the intended assertions ran.
Bind verification to an exact candidate snapshot or tree digest, preserving raw outcomes and execution identity.
Exercise service startup/readiness/stop timeouts and descendant cleanup in separate bounded evidence.
decision: The 3.0.1 timeout correction is supported by this independent rerun. Further hardening is recommended before treating arbitrary contract green as broad product or autonomous-system acceptance.
